name: pano-plugin-market
description: Flexible plugin that lets you easily list, manage, and sell products on your website.

scripts.test: bun test src scripts && bun scripts/check-locales.mjs
scripts.check:panel: bun scripts/check-build.js --side panel && bun test src/panel --pass-with-no-tests && bun scripts/check-locales.mjs && bun scripts/check-i18n.js --side panel && bun scripts/check-static.js --side panel
scripts.check:theme: bun scripts/check-build.js --side theme && bun test src/theme --pass-with-no-tests && bun scripts/check-theme.js && bun scripts/check-i18n.js --side theme && bun scripts/check-static.js --side theme
scripts.check:ui: bun run check:build && bun run check:i18n && bun run check:static && bun run lint:prettier
scripts.lint:prettier: prettier -c rollup.config.js package.json scripts src/main.js src/main.test.js src/i18n.js src/panel/register.js src/theme/register.js --config .prettierrc
